calculation_steps: Substitute w_ij=w_++w_-, w_ji=w_+-w_-, Xi_ij=Xi_++Xi_-, Xi_ji=Xi_+-Xi_- into Q24; mixed products cancel.
With Xi_+=0 and w_-(0)=0, c(0)=0 even with pressure-dependent reciprocal w_+.
Smooth drive reversal makes w_- odd; linear physical source C(v)=vC1+O(v³); finite K,D give Gamma=v² C1 K0^-1 D0 K0^-1 C1^T+O(v³).
Under separately assumed F=-Gamma(v)v, force starts cubic; scalar leading load slope is 2 chi'/chi+d'/d-2k'/k.

result.exact_expression: c=eta(w+Xi+ + w-Xi-); signed route and reciprocal w imply c(0)=0; frozen material Gamma=O(v²), F=O(v³)
result.approximation: Taylor expansion near v=0 under smoothness; finite rational values illustrate only
result.units: native dimensionless until physical source map; Gamma physical energy*time/length²
result.precision_and_error: exact symbolic and rational witness; no numerical physical error estimate
result.scope: conditional Q24 identification, signed-route branch and frozen-coefficient passive response

counterexamples_and_failures: Exchange-even Xi and reciprocal w yield nonzero c=eta w+Xi+; signed route with static nonreciprocal w also survives.
No native Q25/Q26 parity or physical Hessian map is derived; memory can invalidate frozen velocity-dependent force prescription.
